title: Cowhead Pure Milk 1L x 1
description:

Cowhead Pure Milk 1L

Cowhead UHT Milk is made from natural fresh cow's milk, creamy and naturally rich in calcium. Cowhead UHT Milk is the ideal nutritious drink!

Cowhead Milk is available in Strawberry, Slim, Lite, Chocolate and Lactose Free variants.

Expiry Date Read as: DD/MM/YYYY.
Please ensure to take videos / photos of items you received and leave us a 5 star rating.
Storage Instructions:
Keep in a cool dry place.
Keep refrigerated after opening.
